en: Illustrated postcard with a bold red background showing caricatured couples dancing energetically, accompanied by a man operating a gramophone that is mounted on a chair. The figures are drawn in a satirical, early‑20th‑century cartoon style. At the bottom, in black capital letters on a white band, is the German title 'APACHENTÄNZE!'. A small logo and the words 'OÖ LANDES-KULTUR GMBH' appear in the lower margin outside the image frame.
